If you do, draw a card' paying CostLife 2. packs in tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/: crossway_troublemakers_attacking_vampires_deathtouch_and_lifelink, crossway_troublemakers_blocking_vampire_no_lifelink_may_decline.

clauses.clause: Attacking Vampires you control have deathtouch and lifelink.
clauses.evidence: Lifelink is seen on the Troublemakers itself ([this creature attacks alone, unblocked]: you gains 5 life by card/DEAL_DAMAGE, 20 -> 25; also when opp_giant blocks it). Deathtouch is never shown (its 5 damage is lethal to the 4/4 giant anyway) and neither is the 'attacking' limit nor the 'Vampires you control' limit. Pack E02_1: an attacking Vampire kills a 0/9 Wall (deathtouch) and gains 1 (lifelink), an attacking Bear does neither; E02_2: a Vampire that is not attacking has neither; E02_3: the opponent's attacking Vampire and my blocking Vampire have neither. E02_8: an attacking Vampire double-blocked may assign 1 deathtouch damage to each blocker: both die, lifelink gains 2.

clauses.clause: Whenever a Vampire you control dies, you may pay 2 life.
clauses.evidence: [this card is dealt lethal damage]: trigger [1] fires on the Troublemakers' own death, ask may [fire, skip] -> fire, you loses 2 life (by card/LOSE_LIFE), 20 -> 18. [your creature (you_bear) dies] and [an opponent's creature (opp_bear) dies]: none. Pack E02_4: another Vampire's death triggers it; E02_6: the opponent's Vampire and my non-Vampire do not.

clauses.clause: If you do, draw a card.
clauses.evidence: Same variant: after the 2 life are paid, you draws you:Library 5#1 (hand 6 -> 7, library 6 -> 5). Pack E02_5: declining (skip) pays nothing and draws nothing; E02_7: with 1 life the 2 cannot be paid, so no draw.
